acceptanceCriteria: Bump the gemini-cli version everywhere it is pinned (gemini-extension.json, hooks/corvint-hook.mjs ADAPTER_VERSION, compatibility.json if present) and `bash script/check-host-package-versions.sh` passes on the branch.
Establish whether CI runs check-host-package-versions; if it does not, wire it into CI so a stale host package version fails the build.
body: On origin/main, `bash script/check-host-package-versions.sh` reports integrations/gemini-cli/gemini-extension.json last bumped at 4a2fe22786d12ac647d414061e6b060321924257, older than the shipped content change at f802b22dc584f47ca0d921dc65d56928b8860de5 (V1-0711 AHI-044 fail-open matrix, merged via beamfall/corvint#531). Expected (AHI-020): the gemini-cli manifest version advances whenever its shipped content changes. Actual: the gate exits nonzero for gemini-cli and CI did not catch it, so its wiring is unverified. Observed 2026-10-04 on 3e72363c / 1912550e by the V1-0773 session. Related but distinct: V1-0452 (OpenCode coverage). Update 2026-10-05: work started in beamfall/corvint#590 (branch claude/gemini-cli-version-bump, gemini-cli 0.2.5 -> 0.2.6 in gemini-extension.json, gemini-cli/compatibility.json and integrations/compatibility.json; check-host-package-versions passes for gemini-cli). Keep OPEN until the CI acceptance criterion lands: the CI doc-gates job does not run the script, only make gate does; wiring it needs a fetch-depth 0 checkout and cannot land until OpenCode is current on main. OpenCode is also stale on main since 88334a0c (V1-0746); beamfall/corvint#589 (V1-0773, OpenCode 0.7.8, stacked on #580) fixes that.
title: Gemini CLI package version is stale on main: check-host-package-versions fails (AHI-020)
